meta.title: DuelCremental | Martí Sabaté
meta.description: Competitive online action prototype in Unity focused on TCP/UDP networking and authoritative world-state replication.

content.title: DuelCremental
about: DuelCremental is a small-scale competitive online prototype where players control simple avatars that move, dash, and shoot to defeat opponents while avoiding map hazards.
The main goal of the project is to build a stable, scalable client–server networking foundation using TCP for lobby/reliable events and UDP for real-time replication.
features: Lobby flow with rooms and text chat (TCP)
World-state replication over UDP with interpolation
Playable combat loop: health, bullets, spike balls, and a timed storm hazard
Round-based progression with a pool of upgrades and post-round selection
Supports 1v1 matches with up to 4 connected clients

details.role: Project Lead & Lead Developer (Gameplay, Systems, Networking, UI)

learnings: Building TCP (lobby/reliable events) and UDP (real-time replication) layers
Defining and serializing replication packets for multiple entity types
Integrating networking with gameplay systems and UI flow
Profiling and reducing packet spam for frequently spawned entities
